name: Extraction Agent
description: Runs vision-based extraction (JDE or EBS taxonomy, per this run's TARGET_ERP) over the Validator Agent's PII-masked invoice page images, decodes the masked field values back, and stores the invoice in the ennvault database (source, email, log_table, plus jde_inv_header/jde_inv_lines for JDE or inv_header/inv_line for EBS). Does not submit to a live ERP -- see the ERP Push Agent.
